2608.25178.title: Lightweight Machine Learning-Driven Monocular Sidewalk Path Extraction for Embedded Micromobility Navigation
2608.25178.paper_summary: Sidewalk-scale path extraction demands perception and planning that run reliably on compact, low-power hardware in cluttered, map-sparse environments. We present a monocular vision pipeline for sidewalk path extraction in micromobility systems that progresses through three design iterations, from a skeleton-graph baseline through distance-transform corridor planning to a lightweight image-space architecture, and provides a systematic comparison of five path-planning methods across both bird's-eye-view (BEV) and image-space domains. A compact SegFormer-B0 student model, trained with a semi-supervised teacher-student framework using OneFormer Swin-L pseudo-labels, achieves a hand-annotated IoU of 0.946 at 11.7 ms per frame, improving over the baseline checkpoint (IoU 0.758, 18.9 ms). In a controlled planner comparison on 32 hand-labeled frames, image-space midpoint planning achieves the lowest lateral center error (14.3 px) at 2.2 ms, a 421x speedup over BEV distance-transform planning (926.8 ms, 65.0 px center error), while maintaining comparable mask-path alignment (98.5% versus 98.6%). A full-video replay across six campus sequences (22,679 frames) confirms that the improved segmentation reduces temporal instability from 1.46% to 0.33% and increases template-path availability from 73.7% to 79.3%. We further show that BEV-only path extraction is fragile in monocular settings: in one profiled run, 99.3% of frames produced no valid BEV path. The final recommended architecture, image-space midpoint primary, image-space distance-transform fallback, and BEV reserved for visualization, runs the full perception-to-path stack in under 50 ms per frame on CPU, making it suitable for embedded pedestrian-speed micromobility systems.
2608.25178.paper_summary_zh: 人行道規模的路徑提取需要在雜亂、地圖稀疏的環境中，依賴於緊湊、低功耗硬體的可靠感知和規劃。我們提出了一種單目視覺管道，用於微型移動系統中的人行道路徑提取，該管道經過三次設計迭代，從骨架圖基線通過距離變換走廊規劃到輕量級圖像空間架構，並系統地比較了五種路徑規劃方法在鳥瞰圖（BEV）和圖像空間領域的表現。一個緊湊的SegFormer-B0學生模型，使用半監督的教師-學生框架和OneFormer Swin-L偽標籤進行訓練，在每幀11.7毫秒的時間內達到了手動標註的IoU為0.946，較基線檢查點（IoU 0.758，18.9毫秒）有所改善。在對32幀手動標記幀的控制規劃器比較中，圖像空間中點規劃在2.2毫秒內實現了最低的橫向中心誤差（14.3像素），比BEV距離變換規劃（926.8毫秒，65.0像素中心誤差）快421倍，同時保持相似的掩膜路徑對齊（98.5%對比98.6%）。在六個校園序列（22,679幀）中的全視頻重播確認，改進的分割將時間不穩定性從1.46%降低到0.33%，並將模板路徑的可用性從73.7%提高到79.3%。我們進一步顯示，僅使用BEV的路徑提取在單目設置中是脆弱的：在一次剖析運行中，99.3%的幀未產生有效的BEV路徑。最終推薦的架構為圖像空間中點主路徑、圖像空間距離變換回退，BEV保留用於可視化，能在CPU上以每幀低於50毫秒的速度運行完整的感知到路徑堆疊，使其適合嵌入式行人速度的微型移動系統。
